author: cc68-tea (/root)
phase: pre-seal independent semantic peer findings resolved

resolution.PT-SEM-1: Conservatively consolidated all36 clothing/accessory removal or interchange candidates, including cleaning/transfer and partial-front detachment. Fourteen complete pairs individually replaced by new substantive motifs, leaving8 items in the shared removal/interchange family.
resolution.PT-SEM-2: Consolidated all12 simple floral representations. Two complete pairs individually replaced, leaving8.
resolution.handwriting: Consolidated the painted handwriting with written-memory motifs, then independently replaced both a date-embroidery pair and the handwritten-note pair, leaving8 written-memory items. An additional typography boundary label conservatively groups these8 with2 printed overlapping-letter items, total10.
resolution.wovenStrips: An additional cross-carrier label counts woven/plaited fabric-strip construction across four pairs, total8.
resolution.spiralBoundary: Peer found12 helical design items, plus2 coiled belt-end storage items. All14 were conservatively consolidated; three entire pairs were individually reauthored as falling dominoes, a forward-inclined solid heel and miniature hanger earrings, leaving8 coil/helix items including belt storage.

addedConceptGlosses.componente-retirado-trocado: A component removed or exchanged from a garment or accessory for styling, cleaning, drying or transfer.
addedConceptGlosses.ornamento-floral-simples: A plain flower or rosette decorates a wearable item across painted, cut-out, living or knotted representations.
addedConceptGlosses.tiras-tecido-entrelacadas: Interlaced or braided fabric strips forming a wearable panel, belt or bracelet.
addedConceptGlosses.texto-decorativo-tecido: Readable personal marks or letters reproduced as textile decoration, consolidated across stitching and printing.
addedConceptGlosses.forma-espiral-helicoidal: A coil, helix or spiral form on a wearable item, including both designed ornament and coiled belt-end storage.
